findings.text: The claim that no reference X-point exists in the persisted parts and that the analytic saddle vocabulary cannot fire from the shipped data is refuted by the parts: diverted-single-null cells-500 carries render_data.analytic_topology.class diverted with x_point_rz_m [1.5013803017894352, -1.0176279706952234] (cells-1000 [1.502509916049071, -1.0187961354585344]), and its redrawn panel draws the blue cross 1.199e-03 m from the closed-form constant, so the analytic saddle vocabulary does fire from shipped data on 2 of 16 panels.

The cited re-render digest 9a2dff44c99e5637 exists nowhere as an artifact; re-rendering the merged tree's weak-rotation-reactor-static cells-1000 part yields ef467c654a11b577, byte-identical to the shipped panel. The pinned-digest half of the claim checks out (6b0a38974ee8b43c, read off edb02142^), so the claim is unverifiable rather than false at the digit a reader is invited to reproduce. Same text in the edb02142 commit body.

EXIT=0 is not in the cited render log; render-job.log ends without an EXIT line. The substance is corroborated by the aggregate's aggregation_lane for the same job (SOLOVEV_AGGREGATE_EXIT=0), so this is a misattribution rather than a false claim.

The sentence 'The four pin cases read limited' names a four-case pin subset that no document or aggregate defines, and is false under the reading 'all sixteen rows of the four cases': 14 of 16 persisted parts read limited with x_point_rz_m null, while diverted-single-null at 500 and 1000 cells reads diverted with a non-null analytic x-point. True only under the reading 'the four cases at the reduced rung'.

Independent review of run r-20260919T140245050849-nia-certificate-analytic-nulls (plan nova:null-identification-authority), reviewing the merged certificate null-pair render at commits edb02142ffacb695e8376ec7f7c31b13e8f5ba9c and d605b0e04f0b61811cb6895b731d9ddeb43ba269, merged c5827f7f053a7e596349a05a05d050750a6eec7f. Performed in an isolated worktree at base 97791daa360e9708c86d43fdc4971a0a1a4c5fca; every reading below was taken first-hand with /home/ITER/mcintos/Code/nova/.venv/bin/python (PYTHONPATH=$PWD, no uv sync, no solve). Logs and artifacts: /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/reports/nova/s19-local/review-of-nia-certificate-analytic-nulls/.

Q1 SOURCES — PASS. _plot draws the analytic set from analytic_topology and the solved set from terminal_topology at benchmarks/solovev_certificate.py:1997 and :2008, each through poloidal.draw_nulls with its own colour (blue #3366cc, ochre #cc7722) and the axis-triangle / x-point-cross vocabulary; the two topologies come from different sources at :2298 (_topology(operator, oracle_state), with the closed-form fallback _analytic_diverted_topology(exact) at :2304 for a diverted read) and :2306 (_topology(operator, terminal_state)), so the analytic marker cannot be the solved read. First-hand reproduction on the persisted weak-rotation-reactor-static cells-1000 part, whose two reads are 62.656 mm apart: the drawn blue triangle sits at the analytic read [6.198333624122601, -1.5681900222830336e-15] and the ochre triangle at the terminal read [6.135899821642391, -0.005268094049888407], each at 0.000e+00 m from its own source and 6.266e-02 m from the other. The panel was redrawn from its render_data alone (verify_markers.log; first-hand-weak-1000.png/.svg).

Q2 PIN CASES — PARTIAL; the landed record overstates. From the persisted parts (verify_parts.log): 14 of the 16 read limited with x_point_rz_m: null (all three static cases at all four rungs; diverted-single-null at 110 and 300 cells), so on those an absent analytic X-point is absence by construction — the part carries no analytic saddle to draw. But diverted-single-null at 500 and 1000 cells reads diverted with a non-null analytic x-point ([1.5013803017894352, -1.0176279706952234] at 500; [1.502509916049071, -1.0187961354585344] at 1000), and the first-hand redraw of the 500-cell panel draws four markers — blue triangle, blue cross, ochre triangle, ochre cross — with the blue cross 1.199e-03 m from the module's closed-form X_POINT_M. The analytic saddle vocabulary therefore does fire from the shipped data on 2 of 16 panels, which the record denies globally (FINDING 1). "The four pin cases" is also undefined in the tree: no document or aggregate defines a four-case pin subset and the aggregate carries no per-row pin field, so docs/plans/null-identification-authority.html:212 is true only under the reading "the four cases at the reduced rung" and false under "all sixteen rows of the four cases".

Q3 MUTATIONS — PASS; both negative controls fire exactly as the record claims. Mutation 1, replacing the analytic draw_nulls call at benchmarks/solovev_certificate.py:1997 with _suppressed_analytic_nulls = (analytic_topology, wall_units): 2 failed, 2 passed in 12.88s, quoting "AssertionError: the flux panel must carry both null sets in their own colours, found ['#cc7722']" and "AssertionError: the analytic saddle must be drawn in the analytic colour, found ['#cc7722']". Mutation 2, adding flux_axis.contourf(radial, height, solved, levels) to _plot: 1 failed, 3 passed in 12.52s, quoting "AssertionError: assert True is False" naming a QuadContourSet. Both reverted — renderer sha256 restored to b14327a0e3de92cc57b5cd13547dc1302906467ee5e3e0e91389aaf5e503b645, git status --porcelain empty — and the as-shipped rerun is 4 passed in 10.40s (mutation1-suppress-analytic.log, mutation2-filled-map.log, as-shipped-render-guard.log).

Q4 RECEIPTS, NO SOLVE, AGREEMENT — PASS. The cited job log /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/reports/nova/s19-local/nia-certificate-analytic-nulls/render-job.log (lane=slurm host=98dci4-clu-3141 job=1274019 partition=all_debug) carries exactly 16 SOLOVEV_RENDER_PERSISTED markers and zero SOLOVEV_COMPILATION_CACHE markers, so no solve ran. All 16 parts carry figure.render_source: persisted_part_receipt; every PNG and SVG digest matches the file on disk (32/32, verify_parts.log png_match/svg_match); the aggregate pin at docs/figures/gs-absolute-accuracy/solovev-certificate-production-route.json equals the part receipts and the files on disk for all 16 rows (verify_digests.log), and the aggregate's aggregation_lane records the same job. An independent re-render of two parts from their persisted render_data in a scratch tree reproduced the shipped bitmaps byte-identically (weak-1000 ef467c654a11b577…, diverted-500 897e56ecb1f82b08…) with no solver (verify_reproduction.log). The SVG digests do not reproduce across runs — they differ in <dc:date> and matplotlib's per-render clip-path ids (svg-diff-weak-1000.txt); that is a property of the vector format, not a defect in the receipt, which matches the file on disk.

Q5 RECORD VERSUS LOGS — PARTIAL; three findings below, rest confirmed. Confirmed: "sixteen SOLOVEV_RENDER_PERSISTED markers" (:895); "every one of the sixteen PNG digests differs from its predecessor" (:895 — measured 16 of 16 between edb02142^ and the merged tree); "8 passed in 22.82 s" (gate.log); "re-rendered … in one all_debug job with no solve" (:212); "the aggregate pin and receipt digests are regenerated by the renderer" (:212).

FINDING docs/evidence/archive/null-identification-authority-landed.html:896 — "a reference X-point does not exist in the persisted parts and the analytic saddle vocabulary cannot fire from the shipped data" is refuted by the persisted parts: diverted-single-null cells-500 carries render_data.analytic_topology.class "diverted" with x_point_rz_m [1.5013803017894352, -1.0176279706952234] (cells-1000: [1.502509916049071, -1.0187961354585344]), and its redrawn panel carries the blue cross 1.199e-03 m from the closed-form constant. Saddle injection is needed by the test only because the part it pins (cells-300) is limited; the shipped data does exercise the real analytic-saddle path on two rows.

FINDING docs/evidence/archive/null-identification-authority-landed.html:894 (and the edb02142 commit body) — the cited re-render digest 9a2dff44c99e5637 exists nowhere as an artifact: a full-history search finds it only inside the two record commits themselves, and re-rendering the merged tree's weak-1000 part yields ef467c654a11b577…, byte-identical to the shipped panel. The other half of the claim checks out — the old pin is 6b0a38974ee8b43c, read off edb02142^ — but a reader cannot reproduce the digit the record invites them to reproduce.

FINDING docs/evidence/archive/null-identification-authority-landed.html:895 — "EXIT=0" is not in the cited render log; render-job.log ends without an EXIT line. The substance is corroborated in the aggregate's aggregation_lane for the same job (SOLOVEV_AGGREGATE_EXIT=0), so this is an attribution defect rather than a false claim.

ABSENT / NOT MEASURED — the "thirteen of sixteen panels were stale" count (:894 and the edb02142 body) is a different measurement from the 16-of-16 digest change: staleness is the pre-change renderer against the old pin, which I did not reproduce (it needs the parent renderer re-run over the old parts). The two numbers are compatible rather than contradictory, because the added analytic markers change every bitmap, so a stale count below sixteen is expected; do not quote either number as the other.

VERDICT pass. Both null sets are drawn from the sources claimed — the analytic set from the closed-form/reference read, the solved set from the terminal solve — verified at the construction site, by the drawn coordinates first-hand, and by both negative controls failing exactly as claimed; and the sixteen panels were re-rendered from persisted parts with no solve in one all_debug job, with receipts, pin and files on disk in agreement. The two record-accuracy findings and the one attribution defect do not change the panels, the guard or the pin; they are corrections for the landed record's prose: name the rows that read limited instead of the cases, drop or reproduce the intermediate digest, and attribute EXIT=0 to the aggregate's lane record.
